graph.title: LEGO 5981-1 Raid VPR
notes: Keeping the two groups separate is correct for this manual, so this is not a real problem. Page 2 builds the alien's handheld gun (b60 space gun + b59 trans-red cone) as its own mini-model, and pages 3-19 build the Raid VPR ship (b1-b58). The gun is carried by the alien minifigure and never attaches to the ship in any step.

Minifigure parts (torsos, legs, heads, helmet, visor, jetpack, alien head) appear in the booklet but not in the 60-piece parts list, so they are not nodes. This is why the gun has nothing to connect to; the graph only holds the listed pieces.
The step 7/8 sub-assemblies (Technic brick + 1x1 Technic brick + two pins) and the step 10 engines are built twice. They are written out flat with distinct ids instead of as repeats.

Exact stud positions on the hull are hard to read from the small pictures. The port names on hull pieces (b1-b9, b37, b39-b48) are best-effort. Which pieces touch is believed correct; the specific stud numbers are approximate.
The step 2/3 hull stack is assumed to be: 4x4 double inverted slope (b2) on the 2x6 plate (b1), then the curved 6x4 inverted brick (b3), with the 3x2 inverted slope (b4) on b2 studs.
Where the 1x4 brick (b10) sits is not clear from the pictures. It is assumed to be on the hull studs inside the nose.
The two fairings are assumed to be b31 (floating wing, red light) and b32 (near wing, blue light). They attach by pins into their pin holes, as drawn in step 12.
The sticker sheet (b58) is one node. Its stickers go on the 1x2 tile, both wings and the tail, so it has joined edges to those parts, with method stick.
The lever (b13) has no anti-stud port in the catalogue, so its edge to the plate uses a null port.
Wing, tile and slope positions are assumed from steps 15-19. b40 is taken as the left wing with the blue tile, and b39 as the right wing with the red tile.
